description: ATOSA domain architecture map: AlphaFold pLDDT profile with HORMA domain, DUF4210, Atos C-terminal and TADs
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q32MH5-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=300).text
pl=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
N=len(pl); x=np.arange(1,N+1)

fig,(ax,ax2)=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.2),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2.2,1]},sharex=True)
ax.fill_between(x,0,pl,where=pl>=90,color="#1f6fb4",label="pLDDT >= 90 (very high)")
ax.fill_between(x,0,pl,where=(pl>=70)&(pl<90),color="#6fa8dc",label="70-90 (confident)")
ax.fill_between(x,0,pl,where=(pl>=50)&(pl<70),color="#f6c445",label="50-70 (low)")
ax.fill_between(x,0,pl,where=pl<50,color="#e8732a",label="< 50 (very low / disordered)")
ax.axhline(70,color="grey",lw=0.8,ls="--")
ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=4,loc="upper center",frameon=False)
ax.set_title("ATOSA / FAM214A (Q32MH5, 1076 aa): AlphaFold confidence and domain architecture\n"
             "57% of residues have pLDDT < 50; the ordered N-terminal module is a HORMA domain (Foldseek, PDB100)",fontsize=11)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

feat=[(1,222,"HORMA domain\n(Foldseek: ATG13/ATG101/MAD2/REV7, E 2e-6)","#c0392b",0.62),
      (24,32,"TAD1","#8e44ad",0.30),
      (878,936,"DUF4210 / Atos-like conserved\n(IPR025261; macrophage-invasion region)","#16a085",0.62),
      (962,970,"TAD2","#8e44ad",0.30),
      (1018,1075,"Atos-like C-terminal\n(IPR033473)","#2980b9",0.62)]
ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((1,0.44),N,0.07,color="#bdc3c7"))
for s,e,lab,c,h in feat:
    ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((s,0.475-h/2),e-s,h,color=c,alpha=0.85))
    ax2.text((s+e)/2, 0.475+h/2+0.04, lab, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5, color=c, weight="bold")
    ax2.text((s+e)/2, 0.475-h/2-0.05, f"{s}-{e}", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=7, color=c)
for s,e in [(232,877),(937,1017)]:
    ax2.text((s+e)/2,0.30,"intrinsically disordered\n(pLDDT < 50)",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#7f8c8d",style="italic")
ax2.text(540,0.86,"no zinc finger, no AT-hook, no HMG/homeodomain/bZIP basic region;\n"
                  "Cys 2.4%, net charge +5; no DNA-binding fold detected in any ordered module",
         ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#2c3e50")
ax2.set_ylim(0,1); ax2.set_yticks([]); ax2.set_xlim(1,N); ax2.set_xlabel("residue")
for sp in ["top","right","left"]: ax2.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("ordered fraction (pLDDT>=70): %.1f%%; HORMA region 1-222 mean pLDDT %.1f; region 878-998 mean %.1f; 232-877 mean %.1f"
      %(100*(pl>=70).mean(), pl[0:222].mean(), pl[877:998].mean(), pl[231:877].mean()))
